data.narrative:
Alice & Bob is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Theau Peronnin and Raphael Lescanne, having raised €100M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 identifiable comparables: 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

The peer-median valuation method was not applicable to this analysis. The quantum computing sector contains only 5 same-sector peers overall, but none met the filter criteria for stage alignment (Series B), adjacent-stage proximity, or comparable valuation tier. Narrowing to same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables yielded fewer than the three minimum datapoints required for reliable median-based valuation. A fallback to all-sector medians would introduce substantial methodological error given the heterogeneity in quantum approaches, business models, and development timelines across the peer set.

The absence of a sufficiently tight comparable cohort prevents triangulation to a definitive valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-relative valuation multiples for early-stage quantum hardware and software companies, the degree to which public market valuations (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) reflect private market risk premiums, and whether the private comparables (Quantinuum, Infleqtion) operate with similar capital efficiency or go-to-market timelines as Alice & Bob. Further analysis would require either expanded peer identification or primary market research into recent Series B transactions in the sector.
